entities.name: Yumegawa River
entities.description: The longest river on Kamigawa and a vital source of blue mana.

entities.name: Kamitaki Falls
entities.description: The largest and widest waterfall in Kamigawa, fed by the Yumegawa.

entities.name: Kamitaki Lake
entities.description: Lake below Kamitaki Falls, rich in blue mana.

entities.name: Minamo Academy
entities.description: Kamigawa's foremost school of magic for human wizards, built on cliffs over the river and falls.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: A Soratami city of cloud and sky floating above Kamitaki Lake.

entities.name: Akagi River
entities.description: A river near the falls where a famous battle between humans and kami took place.

entities.name: Kawabe Province
entities.description: A land downriver from Kamitaki, where Lady Azami was from.

relations.quote: The Yumegawa River is the longest river on the plane of Kamigawa

relations.note: Built on cliffs overlooking the river and falls.
relations.quote: is built on cliffs overlooking both the river and the thunderous falls
